item.title: UAE’s Wynn Al Marjan Casino Ramps Up Hiring, Adds Staff Housing
item.description: Getting approval for the UAE's first casino was tough enough. Now Wynn needs the right staff.

item.title: Indian Hotels Company’s Boutique Acquisition: Brij Hospitality’s Next Move
item.description: IHCL is acquiring smaller chains to make the most of the hospitality boom in India. But it does not seem interested in overhauling how these chains actually operate as long as their models work.

item.title: IndiGo CEO Bets on ‘Fit-For-Purpose Flying’ and Explains What Went Wrong in December
item.description: IndiGo wants to grow beyond its low-cost roots without losing price-sensitive flyers. But, December showed that growth and resilience don’t always move together. What and how it fixes next will matter.

item.title: Accor Launches App in ChatGPT to Compete for Early Bookings
item.description: ChatGPT isn’t replacing hotel distribution yet, but it’s becoming too important for hotels to ignore as AI reshapes how trips are planned.

item.title: Boutique Hotels Were Rebels. Can They Survive the Corporate ‘Lifestyle’ Takeover?
item.description: Lifestyle hotels have moved from niche rebellion to mainstream strategy. As the model spreads, can it still surprise guests, or does scale make ‘cool’ start to look the same?

item.title: Southwest CEO Defends Changes: ‘We’re Committed to Following the Customer’
item.description: Southwest CEO Bob Jordan doubled down on the changes at the carrier as initiatives like assigned seating and baggage fees take off.

item.title: American Airlines to Return to Venezuela
item.description: American’s announcement comes as the Trump administration is pushing for more investment in Venezuelan oil from U.S. oil companies.

item.title: Online Travel Agency Kiwi Lays Off 250 Staff in Latest Round of Cuts
item.description: Kiwi has been struggling for the past couple of years — this is its second round of layoffs since 2024.

item.title: Expedia’s Layoff Filing Signals Where Its Restructuring Is Biting
item.description: Expedia’s Seattle WARN filing does more than quantify the 162 job cuts. The mix of eliminated technical roles — including a VP — shows how the company’s efficiency push is reshaping where core work gets done.

item.title: Trump Says U.S. Will Decertify Canadian Aircraft, Threatens 50% Tariffs
item.description: It is unclear if a decertification could impact aircraft beyond Bombardier’s business jets.
